  // stage/geometry.js
  var finite = (n, fallback = 0) => Number.isFinite(n) ? n : fallback;
  var clamp = (n, lo, hi) => Math.min(Math.max(finite(n, lo), lo), Math.max(lo, hi));
  function rect(value) {
    if (!value) return null;
    const left = finite(value.left, finite(value.x));
    const top = finite(value.top, finite(value.y));
    const width = Math.max(0, finite(value.width, finite(value.right, left) - left));
    const height = Math.max(0, finite(value.height, finite(value.bottom, top) - top));
    return { x: left, y: top, left, top, width, height, right: left + width, bottom: top + height };
  }
  function intersection(a, b) {
    const left = Math.max(a.left, b.left), top = Math.max(a.top, b.top);
    const right = Math.max(left, Math.min(a.right, b.right));
    const bottom = Math.max(top, Math.min(a.bottom, b.bottom));
    return rect({ left, top, width: right - left, height: bottom - top });
  }
  function pointIn(bounds, point) {
    return { x: clamp(point.x, bounds.left, bounds.right), y: clamp(point.y, bounds.top, bounds.bottom) };
  }
  function fitsActor(bounds, size, point) {
    return point.x >= bounds.left && point.y >= bounds.top && point.x + size.width <= bounds.right && point.y + size.height <= bounds.bottom;
  }
  function overlapActor(point, size, obstacle) {
    return obstacle && point.x < obstacle.right && point.x + size.width > obstacle.left && point.y < obstacle.bottom && point.y + size.height > obstacle.top;
  }
  function peripheralPoints(geometry) {
    const { bounds: b, board, actorSize: s } = geometry;
    if (!board || !overlapActor({ x: b.left, y: b.top }, { width: b.width, height: b.height }, board)) {
      return [
        clampActor(geometry, { x: b.left, y: b.maxY }),
        clampActor(geometry, { x: b.maxX, y: b.maxY }),
        clampActor(geometry, { x: b.maxX, y: b.top }),
        { x: b.left, y: b.top }
      ];
    }
    const free = {
      left: board.left - b.left - s.width,
      right: b.right - board.right - s.width,
      bottom: b.bottom - board.bottom - s.height,
      top: board.top - b.top - s.height
    };
    const available = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(free).map(([side, space]) => [side, space >= 0]));
    const gap = (side) => Math.min(12, Math.max(0, free[side]));
    const xL = available.left ? board.left - s.width - gap("left") : b.left;
    const xR = available.right ? board.right + gap("right") : b.maxX;
    const yB = available.bottom ? board.bottom + gap("bottom") : b.maxY;
    const yT = available.top ? board.top - s.height - gap("top") : b.top;
    const nodes = [{ x: xL, y: yB }, { x: xR, y: yB }, { x: xR, y: yT }, { x: xL, y: yT }];
    if (Object.values(available).every(Boolean)) return nodes;
    const edges = [[0, 1, "bottom"], [1, 2, "right"], [2, 3, "top"], [3, 0, "left"]];
    const first = available.left ? 0 : available.bottom ? 0 : available.right ? 1 : available.top ? 2 : -1;
    if (first === -1) return [];
    const route = [first], visited = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([first]);
    const walk = (node) => {
      for (const [a, c, side] of edges) {
        const next = a === node ? c : c === node ? a : -1;
        if (next < 0 || !available[side] || visited.has(next)) continue;
        visited.add(next);
        route.push(next);
        walk(next);
        route.push(node);
      }
    };
    walk(first);
    if (route.length > 1) route.pop();
    return route.map((index) => nodes[index]);
  }
  function avatarApproach(geometry) {
    const { bounds, actorSize: size, avatarBounds: target, avatarTarget: aim } = geometry;
    if (!target) return { ...geometry.home, side: "restpoint" };
    const palmY = clamp(aim.y - size.height * 0.676, bounds.top, bounds.maxY);
    const palmX = clamp(aim.x - size.width * 0.545, bounds.left, bounds.maxX);
    const candidates = [
      { x: target.left - size.width - 8, y: palmY, side: "left" },
      { x: target.right + 8, y: palmY, side: "right" },
      { x: palmX, y: target.bottom + 8, side: "bottom" },
      { x: palmX, y: target.top - size.height - 8, side: "top" }
    ];
    return candidates.find((point) => fitsActor(bounds, size, point) && !overlapActor(point, size, target)) ?? { ...geometry.home, side: "restpoint" };
  }
  function measureGeometry({
    rootRect,
    rootSize,
    boardRect,
    avatarRect,
    cardRect,
    roomRect,
    viewportRect,
    actorSize = { width: 96, height: 96 }
  } = {}) {
    const root = rect(rootRect) ?? rect({ width: 0, height: 0 });
    const width = Math.max(0, finite(rootSize?.width, finite(rootSize?.clientWidth, root.width)));
    const height = Math.max(0, finite(rootSize?.height, finite(rootSize?.clientHeight, root.height)));
    const scaleX = root.width > 0 && width > 0 ? root.width / width : 1;
    const scaleY = root.height > 0 && height > 0 ? root.height / height : 1;
    const localRect = (value) => {
      const r = rect(value);
      return r ? rect({
        left: (r.left - root.left) / scaleX,
        top: (r.top - root.top) / scaleY,
        width: r.width / scaleX,
        height: r.height / scaleY
      }) : null;
    };
    const localRoot = rect({ width, height });
    let bounds = intersection(localRoot, localRect(roomRect) ?? localRoot);
    bounds = intersection(bounds, localRect(viewportRect) ?? localRoot);
    bounds = rect({
      left: clamp(bounds.left, 0, width),
      top: clamp(bounds.top, 0, height),
      width: Math.min(bounds.width, Math.max(0, width - bounds.left)),
      height: Math.min(bounds.height, Math.max(0, height - bounds.top))
    });
    const desiredWidth = Math.max(1, finite(actorSize?.width, 96));
    const desiredHeight = Math.max(1, finite(actorSize?.height, 96));
    const fit = Math.min(1, bounds.width / desiredWidth, bounds.height / desiredHeight);
    const size = { width: desiredWidth * fit, height: desiredHeight * fit };
    Object.assign(bounds, {
      minX: bounds.left,
      minY: bounds.top,
      maxX: Math.max(bounds.left, bounds.right - size.width),
      maxY: Math.max(bounds.top, bounds.bottom - size.height)
    });
    const board = localRect(boardRect);
    const geometry = {
      root: localRoot,
      bounds,
      board,
      actorSize: size,
      scale: { x: scaleX, y: scaleY },
      visible: bounds.width > 0 && bounds.height > 0,
      home: { x: bounds.left, y: bounds.maxY },
      perimeter: [],
      avatarTarget: null,
      avatarBounds: null,
      avatarApproach: null
    };
    geometry.perimeter = peripheralPoints(geometry);
    geometry.home = geometry.perimeter[0] ?? clampActor(geometry, geometry.home);
    if (!geometry.perimeter.length) geometry.perimeter = [geometry.home];
    for (const [source, candidate] of [["avatar", avatarRect], ["card", cardRect]]) {
      const local = localRect(candidate);
      const visible = local && intersection(bounds, local);
      if (visible?.width > 0 && visible?.height > 0) {
        geometry.avatarBounds = local;
        geometry.avatarTarget = {
          x: visible.left + visible.width / 2,
          y: visible.top + visible.height / 2,
          source
        };
        break;
      }
    }
    geometry.avatarTarget ??= { ...pointIn(bounds, {
      x: geometry.home.x + size.width * 0.545,
      y: geometry.home.y + size.height * 0.676
    }), source: "restpoint" };
    geometry.avatarApproach = avatarApproach(geometry);
    return geometry;
  }
  function boardPoint(geometry, row, col) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(row) || !Number.isInteger(col) || row < 0 || row > 14 || col < 0 || col > 14)
      return null;
    const b = geometry?.board;
    if (!b || b.width <= 0 || b.height <= 0) return null;
    return {
      x: b.left + (col + 0.5) * b.width / 15,
      y: b.top + (14 - row + 0.5) * b.height / 15
    };
  }
  function clampActor(geometry, point = {}) {
    const b = geometry.bounds, size = geometry.actorSize;
    return {
      x: clamp(point.x, b.left, b.right - size.width),
      y: clamp(point.y, b.top, b.bottom - size.height)
    };
  }
  function bubblePosition(geometry, actor, bubbleSize = { width: 190, height: 68 }) {
    const b = geometry.bounds;
    const width = Math.min(b.width, Math.max(0, finite(bubbleSize.width, 190)));
    const height = Math.min(b.height, Math.max(0, finite(bubbleSize.height, 68)));
    const a = clampActor(geometry, actor);
    const above = a.y - height - 8;
    const placement = above >= b.top ? "above" : "below";
    return {
      x: clamp(a.x + geometry.actorSize.width / 2 - width / 2, b.left, b.right - width),
      y: clamp(placement === "above" ? above : a.y + geometry.actorSize.height + 8, b.top, b.bottom - height),
      width,
      height,
      placement
    };
  }

  // stage/motion-director.js
  var RIGHT_PALM = Object.freeze({ x: 0.545, y: 0.676 });
  var MOTION_TIMEOUT_MS = 12e3;
  var MOVE = Object.freeze([
    ["thinking", 550, "thinking"],
    ["pickup", 550, "pickup"],
    ["carrying", 1750, "walk"],
    ["placing", 700, "place"],
    ["smug", 700, "smug"],
    ["retreat", 1650, "walk"]
  ]);
  var DEFEAT = Object.freeze([
    ["pout", 500, "pout"],
    ["stomp", 550, "stomp"],
    ["run-avatar", 1500, "walk"],
    ["punch", 350, "punch"],
    ["punch", 350, "punch"],
    ["punch", 350, "punch"],
    ["arms-crossed", 650, "arms-crossed"],
    ["invite", 650, "invite"],
    ["retreat", 1400, "walk"]
  ]);
  var RELEASE_AT = 550 + 550 + 1750 + 700 * 0.65;
  var total = (sequence) => sequence.reduce((sum2, item) => sum2 + item[1], 0);
  var ease = (t) => {
    const u = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
    return u * u * (3 - 2 * u);
  };
  var mix = (a, b, t) => ({ x: a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t, y: a.y + (b.y - a.y) * t });
  var validId = (v) => typeof v === "string" && v.trim().length > 0 && v.length <= 512 || Number.isSafeInteger(v) && v >= 0;
  var versionOK = (v) => Number.isSafeInteger(v) && v >= 0;
  var colorOK = (c) => c === 1 || c === 2;
  var contains = (g, p) => p && g.visible && p.x >= g.bounds.left && p.x <= g.bounds.right && p.y >= g.bounds.top && p.y <= g.bounds.bottom;
  var clampHand = (g, p) => ({
    x: Math.max(g.bounds.left, Math.min(g.bounds.right, p.x)),
    y: Math.max(g.bounds.top, Math.min(g.bounds.bottom, p.y))
  });
  var clearRoamPath = (g, a, b) => {
    if (!g.board || g.board.width <= 0 || g.board.height <= 0) return true;
    let enter = 0, exit = 1;
    for (const [axis, low, high] of [
      ["x", g.board.left - g.actorSize.width, g.board.right],
      ["y", g.board.top - g.actorSize.height, g.board.bottom]
    ]) {
      const delta = b[axis] - a[axis];
      if (Math.abs(delta) < 1e-9) {
        if (a[axis] <= low || a[axis] >= high) return true;
        continue;
      }
      const t1 = (low - a[axis]) / delta, t2 = (high - a[axis]) / delta;
      enter = Math.max(enter, Math.min(t1, t2));
      exit = Math.min(exit, Math.max(t1, t2));
      if (enter >= exit) return true;
    }
    return enter >= exit;
  };
  function defaultClock() {
    const g = globalThis;
    const now = () => g.performance?.now?.() ?? Date.now();
    return {
      now,
      request: (callback) => typeof g.requestAnimationFrame === "function" ? g.requestAnimationFrame(callback) : g.setTimeout(() => callback(now()), 16),
      cancel: (id) => typeof g.cancelAnimationFrame === "function" ? g.cancelAnimationFrame(id) : g.clearTimeout(id),
      timeout: (callback, ms) => g.setTimeout(callback, ms),
      clearTimeout: (id) => g.clearTimeout(id)
    };
  }
  var MotionDirector = class {
    constructor({ measure, emit = () => {
    }, clock, role, actionProfile } = {}) {
      if (typeof measure !== "function") throw new TypeError("MotionDirector requires measure()");
      this.measure = measure;
      this.emit = emit;
      this.clock = clock ?? defaultClock();
      this.role = role;
      this.actionProfile = actionProfile;
      for (const method of ["now", "request", "cancel", "timeout", "clearTimeout"])
        if (typeof this.clock[method] !== "function") throw new TypeError(`clock.${method} is required`);
      this.gameId = null;
      this.version = 0;
      this.quiet = false;
      this.reducedMotion = false;
      this.disposed = false;
      this.active = null;
      this.frame = null;
      this.watchdog = null;
      this.generation = 0;
      this.frameGeneration = 0;
      this.seenEvents = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
      this.seenMoves = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
      this.roamIndex = 0;
      const g = this._geometry();
      this.model = this._idle(g, g.home);
    }
    get busy() {
      return this.active !== null && this.active.kind !== "roam";
    }
    _geometry() {
      try {
        const g = this.measure();
        if (g?.bounds && g.actorSize && g.home) {
          this.geometry = g;
          return g;
        }
      } catch {
      }
      return measureGeometry();
    }
    _hand(g, position, facing = "right") {
      return clampHand(g, {
        x: position.x + g.actorSize.width * (facing === "left" ? 1 - RIGHT_PALM.x : RIGHT_PALM.x),
        y: position.y + g.actorSize.height * RIGHT_PALM.y
      });
    }
    _idle(g, position) {
      const p = clampActor(g, position);
      return {
        phase: "idle",
        ...p,
        width: g.actorSize.width,
        height: g.actorSize.height,
        facing: "right",
        track: "idle",
        hand: this._hand(g, p),
        heldStone: null,
        hiddenMoveId: null,
        avatarFeedback: null,
        bubble: null,
        eventId: null,
        gameId: this.gameId,
        version: this.version
      };
    }
    _publish(model) {
      this.model = model;
      const previous = this.emitting;
      this.emitting = true;
      try {
        this.emit({
          ...model,
          hand: { ...model.hand },
          heldStone: model.heldStone && { ...model.heldStone },
          avatarFeedback: model.avatarFeedback && { ...model.avatarFeedback }
        });
      } finally {
        this.emitting = previous;
      }
    }
    _cancelFrame() {
      this.frameGeneration++;
      if (this.frame !== null) this.clock.cancel(this.frame);
      this.frame = null;
    }
    _clearTimers() {
      this._cancelFrame();
      if (this.watchdog !== null) this.clock.clearTimeout(this.watchdog);
      this.watchdog = null;
    }
    _stop(reason, home = false) {
      this.generation++;
      this._clearTimers();
      this.active = null;
      const g = this._geometry();
      this.lastCancelReason = reason;
      this._publish(this._idle(g, home ? g.home : this.model));
    }
    reset({ gameId, version } = {}) {
      if (this.disposed || !validId(gameId) || !versionOK(version)) return false;
      if (this.gameId === gameId && version < this.version) return false;
      if (this.gameId !== gameId) {
        this.seenEvents.clear();
        this.seenMoves.clear();
      }
      this.gameId = gameId;
      this.version = version;
      this._stop("reset", true);
      return true;
    }
    updateAuthority(snapshot) {
      if (this.disposed) return false;
      const value = snapshot?.game ?? snapshot;
      const gameId = value?.gameId ?? value?.id, version = value?.version;
      if (!validId(gameId) || !versionOK(version)) return false;
      if (this.gameId !== gameId) return this.reset({ gameId, version });
      if (version < this.version) return false;
      if (version > this.version) {
        this.version = version;
        this._stop("authority-advanced");
      }
      return true;
    }
    _accept(event, kind) {
      if (this.disposed || event?.confirmed !== true || this.gameId === null || event.gameId !== this.gameId || !versionOK(event.version) || event.version < this.version || !validId(event.eventId) || this.seenEvents.has(event.eventId)) return false;
      if (kind === "move" && (!validId(event.moveId) || this.seenMoves.has(event.moveId) || !colorOK(event.color) || !Number.isInteger(event.row) || !Number.isInteger(event.col) || event.row < 0 || event.row > 14 || event.col < 0 || event.col > 14)) return false;
      if (kind === "defeat" && (event.status !== "won" || !colorOK(event.playerColor) || event.winner !== event.playerColor)) return false;
      this.version = event.version;
      this.seenEvents.add(event.eventId);
      if (kind === "move") this.seenMoves.add(event.moveId);
      return true;
    }
    playMove(event) {
      return this._play(event, "move");
    }
    playDefeat(event) {
      return this._play(event, "defeat");
    }
    _play(event, kind) {
      if (!this._accept(event, kind)) return false;
      const stoppedGeneration = this.generation + 1;
      this._stop("superseded");
      if (this.disposed || this.generation !== stoppedGeneration || this.gameId !== event.gameId || this.version !== event.version) return true;
      const g = this._geometry();
      if (this.reducedMotion || !g.visible || kind === "move" && !contains(g, boardPoint(g, event.row, event.col))) {
        this._publish(this._idle(g, g.home));
        return true;
      }
      this._begin(kind, { ...event }, this.actionProfile?.[kind] ?? (kind === "move" ? MOVE : DEFEAT));
      return true;
    }
    _begin(kind, event, sequence, target) {
      const token = ++this.generation;
      this.active = {
        kind,
        event,
        sequence,
        target,
        token,
        start: this.clock.now(),
        origin: { x: this.model.x, y: this.model.y },
        segment: -1,
        segmentOrigin: { x: this.model.x, y: this.model.y },
        released: false
      };
      this.watchdog = this.clock.timeout(() => {
        if (!this.disposed && this.active?.token === token) this._stop("timeout", true);
      }, MOTION_TIMEOUT_MS);
      this._tick(token);
    }
    _bubble(phase) {
      if (this.quiet) return null;
      const defaults = {
        thinking: "\u8FD9\u6B65\uFF0C\u60F3\u597D\u4E86\u3002",
        pickup: "\u62FF\u7A33\u4E86\uFF0C\u770B\u8FD9\u91CC\u3002",
        smug: "\u8FD9\u624B\u8FD8\u4E0D\u9519\u5427\uFF1F",
        pout: "\u54FC\uFF0C\u8FD9\u5C40\u7B97\u4F60\u7684\u3002",
        invite: "\u518D\u6765\u4E00\u5C40\uFF01"
      };
      const custom = this.role?.bubbles?.[phase];
      if (typeof custom === "string") return custom || null;
      return defaults[phase] ? Array.from(defaults[phase]).slice(0, 40).join("") : null;
    }
    _tick(token) {
      const a = this.active;
      if (this.disposed || !a || a.token !== token) return;
      this.frame = null;
      const elapsed = Math.max(0, this.clock.now() - a.start);
      if (!Number.isFinite(elapsed) || elapsed >= MOTION_TIMEOUT_MS) {
        this._stop("timeout", true);
        return;
      }
      const g = this._geometry();
      const event = a.event;
      const board = a.kind === "move" ? boardPoint(g, event.row, event.col) : null;
      if (!g.visible || a.kind === "move" && !contains(g, board)) {
        this._stop("layout-clipped", true);
        return;
      }
      if (elapsed >= total(a.sequence)) {
        const point2 = a.kind === "roam" ? a.target(g) : g.home;
        this._clearTimers();
        this.active = null;
        this._publish(this._idle(g, point2));
        return;
      }
      let index = 0, start = 0;
      while (index < a.sequence.length - 1 && elapsed >= start + a.sequence[index][1]) {
        start += a.sequence[index++][1];
      }
      const [phase, duration2, track] = a.sequence[index], progress = (elapsed - start) / duration2;
      if (index !== a.segment) {
        a.segment = index;
        a.segmentOrigin = clampActor(g, this.model);
        a.segmentOriginHand = this.model.hand ? { ...this.model.hand } : null;
      }
      const origin = clampActor(g, a.segmentOrigin);
      let point = clampActor(g, this.model), facing = this.model.facing;
      const contactPalm = this.actionProfile?.releasePalm ?? RIGHT_PALM;
      const align = (target2) => clampActor(g, {
        x: target2.x - g.actorSize.width * contactPalm.x,
        y: target2.y - g.actorSize.height * contactPalm.y
      });
      let target = null;
      if (phase === "carrying") target = align(board);
      if (phase === "run-avatar") target = g.avatarApproach ?? align(g.avatarTarget);
      if (phase === "retreat") target = g.home;
      if (phase === "roam") {
        target = a.target(g);
        if (!clearRoamPath(g, origin, target)) {
          this._stop("roam-path-blocked", true);
          return;
        }
      }
      if (target) {
        point = clampActor(g, mix(origin, target, ease(progress)));
        if (Math.abs(target.x - origin.x) > 0.1) facing = target.x >= origin.x ? "right" : "left";
      }
      if (phase === "placing" || phase === "smug") {
        point = align(board);
        facing = "right";
      }
      if (a.kind === "defeat" && ["punch", "arms-crossed", "invite"].includes(phase)) {
        point = clampActor(g, g.avatarApproach ?? align(g.avatarTarget));
      }
      if (a.kind === "defeat" && ["run-avatar", "punch", "arms-crossed", "invite"].includes(phase))
        facing = g.avatarTarget.x >= point.x + g.actorSize.width / 2 ? "right" : "left";
      const profile = this.actionProfile, phaseElapsed = elapsed - start;
      const palm = profile?.palm(phase, phaseElapsed, facing);
      let desiredStone = null;
      if (profile && (phase === "carrying" || phase === "placing" && phaseElapsed < profile.placementMs)) {
        const approach = { x: board.x + 20, y: board.y - 16 };
        const from = a.segmentOriginHand ?? approach;
        desiredStone = phase === "carrying" ? mix(from, approach, ease(progress)) : mix(from, board, ease(Math.min(1, phaseElapsed / profile.placementMs)));
        point = clampActor(g, {
          x: desiredStone.x - g.actorSize.width * palm.x,
          y: desiredStone.y - g.actorSize.height * palm.y
        });
      }
      let hand = palm ? clampHand(g, {
        x: point.x + g.actorSize.width * palm.x,
        y: point.y + g.actorSize.height * palm.y
      }) : this._hand(g, point, facing);
      if (!profile && phase === "placing") hand = clampHand(g, mix(hand, board, ease(Math.min(1, progress / 0.65))));
      if (desiredStone) {
        if (Math.hypot(hand.x - desiredStone.x, hand.y - desiredStone.y) > 1) {
          this._stop("anchor-clipped", true);
          return;
        }
      }
      let avatarFeedback = null;
      if (phase === "punch") {
        const punch = a.sequence.slice(0, index + 1).filter((segment) => segment[0] === "punch").length;
        if (profile) {
          if (phaseElapsed >= profile.punchContact && phaseElapsed < profile.punchFeedbackEnd)
            avatarFeedback = {
              shake: 3 * Math.sin((phaseElapsed - profile.punchContact) * Math.PI / 80),
              stars: 3,
              pulseId: `${event.eventId}:punch:${punch}`
            };
        } else {
          const reach = Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.min(1, progress));
          hand = clampHand(g, mix(hand, g.avatarTarget, reach));
          if (progress >= 0.35) avatarFeedback = {
            shake: 4 * Math.sin(progress * Math.PI * 6),
            stars: 3,
            pulseId: `${event.eventId}:punch:${punch}`
          };
        }
      }
      if (a.kind === "move" && elapsed >= (profile?.releaseAt ?? RELEASE_AT)) a.released = true;
      const holding = a.kind === "move" && !a.released && elapsed >= (profile?.holdAt ?? 550 + 550 * 0.5);
      this._publish({
        phase,
        ...point,
        width: g.actorSize.width,
        height: g.actorSize.height,
        ...profile ? {
          actionClock: "dsh-chess-ai-v1",
          phaseElapsed,
          phaseDuration: duration2,
          segmentIndex: index,
          stoneColor: event?.color ?? null
        } : {},
        facing,
        track,
        hand,
        heldStone: holding ? { moveId: event.moveId, color: event.color, ...hand } : null,
        hiddenMoveId: a.kind === "move" && !a.released ? event.moveId : null,
        avatarFeedback,
        bubble: this._bubble(phase),
        eventId: event?.eventId ?? null,
        gameId: this.gameId,
        version: this.version
      });
      if (!this.disposed && this.active?.token === token) {
        const ticket = ++this.frameGeneration;
        this.frame = this.clock.request(() => {
          if (ticket === this.frameGeneration) this._tick(token);
        });
      }
    }
    /** ResizeObserver/scroll hook: remeasure now, preserving one RAF and the wall deadline. */
    reflow() {
      if (this.disposed || this.emitting) return false;
      if (this.active) {
        const token = this.active.token;
        this._cancelFrame();
        this._tick(token);
      } else {
        const g = this._geometry();
        let point = clampActor(g, this.model);
        const overlaps = (p) => g.board && p.x < g.board.right && p.x + g.actorSize.width > g.board.left && p.y < g.board.bottom && p.y + g.actorSize.height > g.board.top;
        if (overlaps(point) && !overlaps(g.home)) point = g.home;
        this._publish(this._idle(g, point));
      }
      return true;
    }
    skip() {
      if (this.disposed) return false;
      this._stop("skip", true);
      return true;
    }
    cancel(reason = "cancel") {
      if (this.disposed) return false;
      this._stop(reason);
      return true;
    }
    setQuiet(value) {
      if (this.disposed) return false;
      this.quiet = !!value;
      if (this.quiet) this._publish({ ...this.model, bubble: null });
      return true;
    }
    setReducedMotion(value) {
      if (this.disposed) return false;
      this.reducedMotion = !!value;
      if (this.reducedMotion) this._stop("reduced-motion", true);
      return true;
    }
    dragTo(point) {
      if (this.disposed || !Number.isFinite(point?.x) || !Number.isFinite(point?.y)) return false;
      this._stop("drag");
      const g = this._geometry();
      this._publish(this._idle(g, point));
      return true;
    }
    roam() {
      if (this.disposed || this.active || this.reducedMotion || this.gameId === null) return false;
      const g = this._geometry();
      if (!g.visible || !g.perimeter?.length) return false;
      const here = (point) => Math.abs(point.x - this.model.x) < 0.1 && Math.abs(point.y - this.model.y) < 0.1;
      let at = g.perimeter[this.roamIndex] && here(g.perimeter[this.roamIndex]) ? this.roamIndex : g.perimeter.findIndex(here);
      let index;
      if (at >= 0) index = (at + 1) % g.perimeter.length;
      else {
        index = g.perimeter.map((point, i) => ({
          i,
          point,
          distance: Math.hypot(point.x - this.model.x, point.y - this.model.y)
        })).filter((item) => clearRoamPath(g, this.model, item.point)).sort((a, b) => a.distance - b.distance)[0]?.i;
      }
      if (index === void 0 || !clearRoamPath(g, this.model, g.perimeter[index])) return false;
      this.roamIndex = index;
      this._begin("roam", null, [["roam", 1700, "walk"]], (current) => current.perimeter[index] ?? current.home);
      return true;
    }
    dispose() {
      if (this.disposed) return;
      this.disposed = true;
      this._stop("dispose");
      this.seenEvents.clear();
      this.seenMoves.clear();
    }
  };

  // stage/frames.js
  var STAGE_ASSET_BASE = "/api/dsh-chess-room/stage-v4/whale-maid";
  function frameDuration(manifest, track, index) {
    const spec = manifest.frames2d.tracks[track];
    if (spec.frameMs) return spec.frameMs[index];
    const encoded = spec.frames[index].match(/_(\d+)\.[^.]+$/);
    const ms = encoded ? Number(encoded[1]) : NaN;
    return Number.isInteger(ms) && ms >= 16 && ms <= 5e3 ? ms : manifest.frames2d.defaultFrameMs ?? 200;
  }
  function frameAt(manifest, track, elapsed = 0, depth = 0) {
    if (!manifest.frames2d.tracks[track]) track = manifest.frames2d.phases.idle;
    const spec = manifest.frames2d.tracks[track], times = spec.frames.map((_, i) => frameDuration(manifest, track, i));
    const duration2 = times.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), time = Math.max(0, Number.isFinite(elapsed) ? elapsed : 0);
    if (spec.loop === false && time >= duration2) {
      if (depth >= 64) {
        const index2 = spec.frames.length - 1;
        return { track, index: index2, name: spec.frames[index2], duration: times[index2] };
      }
      return frameAt(manifest, spec.fallback ?? manifest.frames2d.phases.idle, time - duration2, depth + 1);
    }
    let remaining = time % duration2, index = 0;
    while (index < times.length - 1 && remaining >= times[index]) remaining -= times[index++];
    return { track, index, name: spec.frames[index], duration: times[index] };
  }
  function frameUrl(manifest, frame, runtimeId = "") {
    const allowed = manifest.frames2d.tracks[frame.track]?.frames.includes(frame.name);
    if (!allowed) throw new Error("undeclared-frame");
    return `${STAGE_ASSET_BASE}/${manifest.frames2d.dir ?? ""}${manifest.frames2d.dir ? "/" : ""}${frame.track}/${frame.name}?r=${encodeURIComponent(runtimeId)}`;
  }
  function motionTrack(role, manifest, phase) {
    const track = role.motions[phase]?.track;
    return manifest.frames2d.tracks[track] ? track : manifest.frames2d.phases.idle;
  }
  function palmAt(role, frame, facing = "right") {
    const p = role.palms.right.frames[frame.track]?.[frame.index] ?? role.palms.right.default;
    return { x: facing === "left" ? 1 - p.x : p.x, y: p.y };
  }

  // stage/preview-data.js
  var PREVIEW_RELEASE = "1.1.0-preview.1";
  function emptyPreview(gameId, version = 0) {
    return { id: gameId, version, board: Array.from({ length: 15 }, () => Array(15).fill(0)), moves: [], status: "playing", winner: null, playerColor: 1, turn: 1, winningLine: [] };
  }
  function previewFixture(kind, gameId, version, eventId) {
    const game = emptyPreview(gameId, version);
    const moves = kind === "defeat" ? [
      [7, 5, 1],
      [5, 2, 2],
      [7, 6, 1],
      [5, 4, 2],
      [7, 7, 1],
      [5, 6, 2],
      [7, 8, 1],
      [5, 8, 2],
      [7, 9, 1]
    ] : [[7, 7, 1], [7, 8, 2]];
    game.moves = moves.map(([row, col, color], index) => ({ row, col, color, moveId: `${gameId}:${version}:move:${index}`, source: color === 1 ? "human" : "model" }));
    for (const m of game.moves) game.board[m.row][m.col] = m.color;
    if (kind === "defeat") {
      Object.assign(game, { status: "won", winner: 1, turn: null, winningLine: Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, i) => ({ row: 7, col: 5 + i })) });
      return { game, event: { kind: "human-victory", gameId, version, eventId, confirmed: true, status: "won", winner: 1, playerColor: 1, preview: true } };
    }
    const move = game.moves.at(-1);
    game.turn = 1;
    return { game, event: { kind: "move-committed", gameId, version, eventId, confirmed: true, ...move, preview: true } };
  }

  function createStageArtwork(React) {
    const h = React.createElement;
    function useFrame(track, runtimeId, reduced) {
      const [frame, setFrame] = React.useState(() => frameAt(pet_default, track, 0));
      React.useEffect(() => {
        let timer, stopped = false, start = performance.now();
        const tick = () => {
          if (stopped) return;
          const f = frameAt(pet_default, track, reduced ? 0 : performance.now() - start);
          setFrame(f);
          if (!reduced && !document.hidden) timer = setTimeout(tick, f.duration);
        };
        const visibility = () => {
          clearTimeout(timer);
          start = performance.now();
          tick();
        };
        tick();
        document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", visibility);
        return () => {
          stopped = true;
          clearTimeout(timer);
          document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", visibility);
        };
      }, [track, runtimeId, reduced]);
      return frame.track === track ? frame : frameAt(pet_default, track, 0);
    }
    function Actor({ model, runtimeId, reduced, t, dragEnabled, onPointerDown, onPointerMove, onPointerUp, onArtError }) {
      const track = motionTrack(chess_role_default, pet_default, model.phase), frame = useFrame(track, runtimeId, reduced);
      const [failure, setFailure] = React.useState(0);
      React.useEffect(() => setFailure(0), [runtimeId, track]);
      if (failure >= 2) return h("div", { className: "dcr-motion-actor dcr-motion-art-unavailable", style: { width: model.width, height: model.height, transform: `translate(${model.x}px,${model.y}px)` } }, "DSH");
      const base = { x: RIGHT_PALM.x, y: RIGHT_PALM.y }, p = palmAt(chess_role_default, frame, model.facing), mirror = model.facing === "left";
      const native = { x: p.x * model.width, y: p.y * model.height };
      const original = { x: (mirror ? 1 - base.x : base.x) * model.width, y: base.y * model.height };
      const contact = ["placing", "punch"].includes(model.phase);
      const hand = { x: model.hand.x - model.x + (contact ? 0 : native.x - original.x), y: model.hand.y - model.y + (contact ? 0 : native.y - original.y) };
      const extension = Math.hypot(hand.x - native.x, hand.y - native.y) > 1.5, stone = model.heldStone;
      const r = Math.max(3.5, model.width * 0.052), skin = "#ffd7c6", cuff = "#24475d";
      const svgChildren = [];
      if (extension) {
        svgChildren.push(h("line", { key: "sleeve", x1: native.x, y1: native.y, x2: hand.x, y2: hand.y, stroke: cuff, strokeWidth: 8, strokeLinecap: "round" }), h("circle", { key: "palm", cx: hand.x, cy: hand.y, r: 5.5, fill: skin, stroke: "#c79d97", strokeWidth: 0.7 }));
      }
      if (stone) {
        svgChildren.push(h("circle", { key: "stone", cx: hand.x, cy: hand.y, r, fill: stone.color === 2 ? "#f4f5f5" : "#26303b", stroke: stone.color === 2 ? "#8b9aab" : "#111c26", strokeWidth: 1 }), h("path", { key: "front-fingers", d: `M ${hand.x + r * 0.9} ${hand.y - r * 0.6} q ${-r * 0.15} ${r} ${-r * 0.65} ${r * 1.1}`, fill: "none", stroke: skin, strokeWidth: 2.8, strokeLinecap: "round" }));
      }
      if (model.phase === "pout") svgChildren.push(h("ellipse", { key: "puff", cx: model.width * 0.23, cy: model.height * 0.41, rx: 6, ry: 4, fill: "#d7e5ee", opacity: 0.8 }));
      if (model.phase === "arms-crossed") svgChildren.push(h("path", { key: "crossed", d: `M ${model.width * 0.34} ${model.height * 0.67} L ${model.width * 0.6} ${model.height * 0.7} M ${model.width * 0.65} ${model.height * 0.65} L ${model.width * 0.41} ${model.height * 0.7}`, stroke: cuff, strokeWidth: 7, strokeLinecap: "round", fill: "none" }));
      return h(
        "div",
        { className: `dcr-motion-actor phase-${model.phase}`, style: { width: model.width, height: model.height, transform: `translate(${model.x}px,${model.y}px)` }, "data-drag": dragEnabled ? "true" : "false", "data-phase": model.phase, onPointerDown, onPointerMove, onPointerUp, onPointerCancel: onPointerUp, onLostPointerCapture: onPointerUp },
        h("div", { className: "dcr-motion-art", style: { width: "100%", height: "100%" } }, h("img", { src: failure === 1 ? `/api/dsh-chess-room/avatar-v2/${track}.png?r=${encodeURIComponent(runtimeId)}` : frameUrl(pet_default, frame, runtimeId), alt: t("art"), draggable: false, style: { transform: mirror ? "scaleX(-1)" : void 0 }, onError: () => {
          setFailure((value) => Math.min(2, value + 1));
          onArtError(failure === 0 ? "stageArtError" : "stageArtUnavailable");
        } }), h("svg", { viewBox: `0 0 ${model.width} ${model.height}`, "aria-hidden": true }, ...svgChildren))
      );
    }
    return Actor;
  }

  // stage/live-events.js
  var LIVE_EVENT_HISTORY_LIMIT = 256;
  var LIVE_EVENT_PENDING_LIMIT = 32;
  var MAX_EVENTS = 512;
  var MAX_MOVES = 225;
  var idOK = (value) => typeof value === "string" && value.trim().length > 0 && value.length <= 512 || Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= 0;
  var versionOK2 = (value) => Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= 0;
  var colorOK2 = (value) => value === 1 || value === 2;
  var cellOK = (value) => Number.isInteger(value) && value >= 0 && value < 15;
  var record = (value) => value !== null && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value);
  var humanWin = (game) => game.status === "won" && game.winner === game.playerColor;
  var sameMove = (a, b) => a.row === b.row && a.col === b.col && a.color === b.color && a.moveId === b.moveId;
  var copyMove = (move) => ({
    row: move.row,
    col: move.col,
    color: move.color,
    ...move.moveId !== void 0 ? { moveId: move.moveId } : {},
    ...move.source !== void 0 ? { source: move.source } : {}
  });
  var copyEvent = (event) => ({ ...event });
  var eventFields = [
    "kind",
    "confirmed",
    "gameId",
    "version",
    "eventId",
    "moveId",
    "row",
    "col",
    "color",
    "status",
    "winner",
    "playerColor",
    "preview"
  ];
  function projectEvent(event) {
    if (!record(event)) return null;
    const projected = {};
    for (const key of eventFields) {
      const value = event[key];
      projected[key] = typeof value === "string" && value.length <= 512 || typeof value === "number" || typeof value === "boolean" || value === null ? value : void 0;
    }
    return projected;
  }
  function boundedLimit(value, fallback, maximum) {
    if (value === void 0) return fallback;
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value < 1 || value > maximum)
      throw new RangeError(`limit must be an integer from 1 to ${maximum}`);
    return value;
  }
  function readSnapshot(snapshot) {
    const game = snapshot?.game;
    if (!record(snapshot) || !idOK(snapshot.runtimeId) || !record(game) || !idOK(game.id) || !versionOK2(game.version) || !colorOK2(game.playerColor) || !["playing", "won", "draw", "resigned"].includes(game.status) || (["playing", "draw"].includes(game.status) ? game.winner !== null : !colorOK2(game.winner)) || !Array.isArray(game.board) || game.board.length !== 15 || !Array.isArray(game.moves) || game.moves.length > MAX_MOVES) return null;
    const board = [];
    for (const row of game.board) {
      if (!Array.isArray(row) || row.length !== 15 || row.some((cell) => cell !== 0 && !colorOK2(cell))) return null;
      board.push([...row]);
    }
    const cells = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(), ids = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(), moves = [];
    for (const move of game.moves) {
      if (!record(move) || !cellOK(move.row) || !cellOK(move.col) || !colorOK2(move.color) || move.moveId !== void 0 && !idOK(move.moveId) || move.source !== void 0 && !["human", "model", "engine"].includes(move.source)) return null;
      const cell = move.row * 15 + move.col;
      if (cells.has(cell) || board[move.row][move.col] !== move.color || move.moveId !== void 0 && ids.has(move.moveId)) return null;
      cells.add(cell);
      if (move.moveId !== void 0) ids.add(move.moveId);
      moves.push(copyMove(move));
    }
    for (let row = 0; row < 15; row++) for (let col = 0; col < 15; col++)
      if (board[row][col] !== 0 && !cells.has(row * 15 + col)) return null;
    const stage = snapshot.stage;
    const stageOK = record(stage) && stage.format === 1 && Array.isArray(stage.events) && stage.events.length <= MAX_EVENTS && (stage.epoch === void 0 || idOK(stage.epoch)) && (stage.gameId === void 0 || stage.gameId === game.id) && (stage.version === void 0 || stage.version === game.version) && (stage.replayThroughVersion === void 0 || versionOK2(stage.replayThroughVersion) && stage.replayThroughVersion <= game.version);
    return {
      runtimeId: snapshot.runtimeId,
      gameId: game.id,
      version: game.version,
      board,
      moves,
      status: game.status,
      winner: game.winner,
      playerColor: game.playerColor,
      comments: typeof snapshot.settings?.comments === "boolean" ? snapshot.settings.comments : true,
      epoch: stageOK ? stage.epoch : void 0,
      stageOK,
      replayThroughVersion: stageOK ? stage.replayThroughVersion ?? 0 : 0,
      events: stageOK ? stage.events.map(projectEvent) : []
    };
  }
  function matchesMove(event, game) {
    const move = game.moves.find((value) => value.moveId === event.moveId);
    return !!move && sameMove(move, event) && move.color === 3 - game.playerColor && move.source !== "human" && game.board[move.row][move.col] === move.color;
  }
  function readEvent(event, game) {
    if (!record(event) || event.confirmed !== true || event.preview === true || event.gameId !== game.gameId || !versionOK2(event.version) || event.version > game.version || event.version <= game.replayThroughVersion || !idOK(event.eventId)) return null;
    const base = {
      kind: event.kind,
      confirmed: event.confirmed,
      gameId: event.gameId,
      version: event.version,
      eventId: event.eventId
    };
    if (event.kind === "move-committed") {
      if (!idOK(event.moveId) || !cellOK(event.row) || !cellOK(event.col) || !colorOK2(event.color) || !matchesMove(event, game)) return null;
      return { ...base, moveId: event.moveId, row: event.row, col: event.col, color: event.color };
    }
    if (event.kind === "human-victory" && event.status === "won" && colorOK2(event.playerColor) && event.playerColor === game.playerColor && event.winner === game.winner && event.winner === event.playerColor && humanWin(game))
      return { ...base, status: event.status, winner: event.winner, playerColor: event.playerColor };
    return null;
  }
  function confirmedMask(game, model) {
    if (!game?.stageOK || humanWin(game) || !idOK(model?.hiddenMoveId) || !idOK(model?.eventId) || model.gameId !== game.gameId || !versionOK2(model.version) || model.runtimeId !== void 0 && model.runtimeId !== game.runtimeId) return null;
    const event = game.events.map((value) => readEvent(value, game)).find((value) => value?.kind === "move-committed" && value.eventId === model.eventId && value.moveId === model.hiddenMoveId && value.version === model.version);
    return event ? copyMove(game.moves.find((move) => move.moveId === event.moveId)) : null;
  }
  function confirmedMoveMask(snapshot, model) {
    return confirmedMask(readSnapshot(snapshot), model);
  }
  var LiveEventFence = class {
    constructor({ historyLimit, pendingLimit } = {}) {
      this.historyLimit = boundedLimit(historyLimit, LIVE_EVENT_HISTORY_LIMIT, MAX_EVENTS);
      this.pendingLimit = boundedLimit(pendingLimit, LIVE_EVENT_PENDING_LIMIT, MAX_MOVES);
      this.current = null;
      this.baselineVersion = 0;
      this.acceptedVersion = 0;
      this.visualVersion = 0;
      this.needsBaseline = false;
      this.seenEvents = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
      this.seenMoves = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
      this.pending = [];
      this.retiredRuntimes = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
      this.retiredGames = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
      this.dispatched = null;
      this.victoryConsumed = false;
    }
    _remember(set, id) {
      if (!idOK(id)) return;
      set.add(id);
      while (set.size > this.historyLimit) set.delete(set.values().next().value);
    }
    _skipEvents(game) {
      for (const event of game.events) if (record(event)) {
        this._remember(this.seenEvents, event.eventId);
        this._remember(this.seenMoves, event.moveId);
      }
    }
    _authority(reset = false) {
      const game = this.current;
      return {
        type: "authority",
        reset,
        runtimeId: game.runtimeId,
        gameId: game.gameId,
        version: this.visualVersion,
        snapshotVersion: game.version,
        board: game.board.map((row) => [...row]),
        moves: game.moves.map(copyMove),
        status: game.status,
        winner: game.winner,
        playerColor: game.playerColor,
        comments: game.comments
      };
    }
    _baseline(game, reason) {
      if (reason === "runtime-change") {
        this._remember(this.retiredRuntimes, this.current.runtimeId);
        this.retiredGames.clear();
      } else if (reason === "game-change") this._remember(this.retiredGames, this.current.gameId);
      this.current = game;
      this.needsBaseline = false;
      this.baselineVersion = this.acceptedVersion = this.visualVersion = game.version;
      this.pending = [];
      this.dispatched = null;
      this.victoryConsumed = humanWin(game);
      if (["first-snapshot", "runtime-change", "game-change"].includes(reason)) {
        this.seenEvents.clear();
        this.seenMoves.clear();
      }
      this._skipEvents(game);
      return [{ type: "cancel", reason }, this._authority(true)];
    }
    consume(snapshot, { busy = false, reconnect = false } = {}) {
      if (reconnect) this.needsBaseline = true;
      const game = readSnapshot(snapshot);
      if (!game) {
        if (this.needsBaseline) return this.disconnect();
        return [];
      }
      const previous = this.current;
      if (!previous) return this._baseline(game, "first-snapshot");
      if (previous.runtimeId !== game.runtimeId) {
        if (this.retiredRuntimes.has(game.runtimeId)) return [];
        return this._baseline(game, "runtime-change");
      }
      if (previous.gameId !== game.gameId) {
        if (this.retiredGames.has(game.gameId)) return [];
        return this._baseline(game, "game-change");
      }
      if (game.version < previous.version) return this.needsBaseline ? this.disconnect() : [];
      if (this.needsBaseline) return this._baseline(game, "reconnect");
      if (game.stageOK && previous.epoch !== game.epoch) return this._baseline(game, "epoch-change");
      if (game.stageOK && game.replayThroughVersion > previous.replayThroughVersion)
        return this._baseline(game, "replay-fence");
      if (game.stageOK && game.replayThroughVersion < previous.replayThroughVersion) return [];
      if (!game.stageOK) {
        game.epoch = previous.epoch;
        game.replayThroughVersion = previous.replayThroughVersion;
      }
      const sameState = previous.playerColor === game.playerColor && previous.status === game.status && previous.winner === game.winner && previous.moves.length === game.moves.length && previous.moves.every((move, index) => sameMove(move, game.moves[index]));
      if (game.version === previous.version && !sameState) return [];
      const extendsMoves = previous.moves.length <= game.moves.length && previous.moves.every((move, index) => sameMove(move, game.moves[index]));
      if (!extendsMoves || previous.playerColor !== game.playerColor || previous.status !== "playing" && (previous.status !== game.status || previous.winner !== game.winner))
        return this._baseline(game, "undo-or-reset");
      this.current = game;
      if (this.dispatched?.kind === "human-victory" && !humanWin(game))
        return this._baseline(game, "terminal-invalidated");
      const events = game.events.map((event, index) => ({ event: readEvent(event, game), index })).filter((value) => value.event).sort((a, b) => a.event.version - b.event.version || a.index - b.index);
      const victory = events.map((value) => value.event).find((event) => event.kind === "human-victory" && event.version > this.baselineVersion && event.version > this.acceptedVersion && !this.seenEvents.has(event.eventId) && !this.victoryConsumed);
      if (victory) {
        this.pending = [];
        this.victoryConsumed = true;
        this.acceptedVersion = this.visualVersion = victory.version;
        this.dispatched = copyEvent(victory);
        for (const { event } of events) if (event.version <= victory.version) {
          this._remember(this.seenEvents, event.eventId);
          if (event.kind === "move-committed") this._remember(this.seenMoves, event.moveId);
        }
        return [
          { type: "cancel", reason: "human-victory" },
          this._authority(false),
          { type: "defeat", event: copyEvent(victory) }
        ];
      }
      const terminalCancel = humanWin(game) && (!humanWin(previous) || this.dispatched?.kind === "move-committed" || this.pending.some((event) => event.kind === "move-committed"));
      if (terminalCancel) {
        this.pending = [];
        this.dispatched = null;
      }
      for (const { event } of events) {
        if (humanWin(game) || event.version <= this.baselineVersion || event.version <= this.acceptedVersion || this.seenEvents.has(event.eventId) || event.kind === "move-committed" && this.seenMoves.has(event.moveId) || event.kind === "human-victory" && this.victoryConsumed) continue;
        this._remember(this.seenEvents, event.eventId);
        if (event.kind === "move-committed") this._remember(this.seenMoves, event.moveId);
        else this.victoryConsumed = true;
        this.acceptedVersion = event.version;
        if (this.pending.length >= this.pendingLimit) return this._baseline(game, "pending-overflow");
        this.pending.push(event);
      }
      const visual = this.drain({ busy });
      return [
        ...terminalCancel ? [{ type: "cancel", reason: "human-victory-sync" }] : [],
        this._authority(false),
        ...visual
      ];
    }
    drain({ busy = false } = {}) {
      if (busy || this.needsBaseline || !this.current) return [];
      while (this.pending.length) {
        const event = this.pending.shift();
        if (!readEvent(event, this.current) || event.version < this.visualVersion) continue;
        this.visualVersion = event.version;
        this.dispatched = copyEvent(event);
        return [{ type: event.kind === "move-committed" ? "move" : "defeat", event: copyEvent(event) }];
      }
      return [];
    }
    disconnect() {
      this.needsBaseline = true;
      this.pending = [];
      this.dispatched = null;
      return [{ type: "cancel", reason: "disconnect" }];
    }
    /** Detached board; only the exact dispatched confirmed stone may be masked. */
    boardFor(model) {
      if (!this.current) return null;
      const board = this.current.board.map((row) => [...row]), event = this.dispatched;
      if (!this.needsBaseline && event?.kind === "move-committed" && model?.gameId === event.gameId && model.version === event.version && model.eventId === event.eventId && model.hiddenMoveId === event.moveId && confirmedMask(this.current, model)) board[event.row][event.col] = 0;
      return board;
    }
    get state() {
      return {
        runtimeId: this.current?.runtimeId ?? null,
        gameId: this.current?.gameId ?? null,
        snapshotVersion: this.current?.version ?? null,
        visualVersion: this.visualVersion,
        baselineVersion: this.baselineVersion,
        queued: this.pending.length,
        seenEvents: this.seenEvents.size,
        seenMoves: this.seenMoves.size,
        needsBaseline: this.needsBaseline
      };
    }
  };

  // stage/live-controller.js
  var bubbles = () => ({ thinking: "", pickup: "", smug: "", pout: "stagePout", invite: "stageInvite" });
  function committedComment(snapshot, event) {
    const index = snapshot?.game?.moves?.findIndex((m) => m.moveId === event.moveId) ?? -1;
    if (index < 0 || snapshot?.settings?.comments === false) return "";
    const message = snapshot.game.chat?.filter((m) => m.who === "dsh" && m.turn === index + 1).at(-1);
    return typeof message?.text === "string" && Array.from(message.text).length <= 60 ? message.text : "";
  }
  var LiveStageController = class {
    constructor({ measure, emit = () => {
    }, clock, actionProfile } = {}) {
      this.measure = measure;
      this.emit = emit;
      this.clock = clock;
      this.actionProfile = actionProfile;
      this.fence = new LiveEventFence();
      this.director = null;
      this.snapshot = null;
      this.enabled = false;
      this.online = false;
      this.quiet = false;
      this.reduced = false;
      this.disposed = false;
      this.model = null;
    }
    _create(gameId, version) {
      this.director?.dispose();
      this.director = new MotionDirector({ measure: this.measure, clock: this.clock, actionProfile: this.actionProfile, role: { bubbles: bubbles() }, emit: (model) => {
        this.model = model;
        this.emit(model);
      } });
      this.director.setQuiet(this.quiet);
      this.director.setReducedMotion(this.reduced);
      this.director.reset({ gameId, version });
    }
    _apply(actions) {
      for (const action of actions) {
        if (action.type === "cancel") this.director?.cancel(action.reason);
        else if (action.type === "authority" && action.reset) this._create(action.gameId, action.version);
        else if (action.type === "move" && this.enabled && this.online) {
          if (!this.director) continue;
          this.director.role = { bubbles: { ...bubbles(), smug: committedComment(this.snapshot, action.event) } };
          this.director.playMove(action.event);
        } else if (action.type === "defeat" && this.enabled && this.online) {
          if (!this.director) continue;
          this.director.role = { bubbles: bubbles() };
          this.director.playDefeat(action.event);
        }
      }
      return actions;
    }
    ingest(snapshot, { enabled = true, online = true, quiet = false, reduced = false } = {}) {
      if (this.disposed) return [];
      const changed = enabled !== this.enabled || online !== this.online;
      this.snapshot = snapshot ? structuredClone(snapshot) : null;
      this.enabled = enabled;
      this.online = online;
      this.quiet = quiet || snapshot?.settings?.comments === false;
      this.reduced = !!reduced;
      this.director?.setQuiet(this.quiet);
      this.director?.setReducedMotion(this.reduced);
      if (!online || !snapshot) {
        return this._apply(this.fence.disconnect());
      }
      return this._apply(this.fence.consume(this.snapshot, { busy: this.director?.busy ?? false, reconnect: changed || !enabled || this.reduced }));
    }
    drain() {
      if (this.disposed || !this.enabled || !this.online) return [];
      return this._apply(this.fence.drain({ busy: this.director?.busy ?? false }));
    }
    cancel(reason = "user-cancel") {
      if (this.disposed) return;
      if (this.snapshot) this._apply(this.fence.consume(this.snapshot, { reconnect: true }));
      this.director?.cancel(reason);
    }
    setQuiet(value) {
      this.quiet = !!value;
      this.director?.setQuiet(this.quiet);
    }
    reflow() {
      this.director?.reflow();
    }
    roam() {
      if (this.enabled && this.online && !this.snapshot?.aiThinking) this.director?.roam();
    }
    dragTo(point) {
      this.director?.dragTo(point);
    }
    get busy() {
      return !!this.director?.busy;
    }
    dispose() {
      if (this.disposed) return;
      this.disposed = true;
      this.director?.dispose();
      this.fence.disconnect();
      this.director = null;
    }
  };

        c.dragTo({ x: p.origin.x + (e.clientX - p.x) / p.scale.x, y: p.origin.y + (e.clientY - p.y) / p.scale.y });
      };
      const geometry = geometryRef.current, bubble = model && geometry ? bubblePosition(geometry, model, { width: 210, height: 68 }) : null;
      const displayModel = model && snapshot?.aiThinking && model.phase === "idle" ? { ...model, phase: "thinking" } : model;
      const text = model?.bubble ? Object.hasOwn(stageZh, model.bubble) ? t(model.bubble) : model.bubble : null;
      return h(React.Fragment, null, h("style", null, stageCss + liveCss), enabled && online && model ? h(
        "div",
        { className: "dcr-live-layer", "data-dcr-live-stage": release2 },
        h(Actor, { model: displayModel, runtimeId: snapshot.runtimeId, reduced: prefs.reduce || systemReduce, t, dragEnabled: prefs.drag && !interactionBusy && !controllerRef.current?.busy, onPointerDown: down, onPointerMove: move, onPointerUp: release2, onArtError: (message) => {
          if (cancelOnArtError) controllerRef.current?.cancel("art-unavailable");
          setArtError(message);
        } }),
        text && !quiet && snapshot?.settings?.comments !== false && bubble ? h("div", { className: "dcr-motion-bubble", style: { left: bubble.x, top: bubble.y, width: bubble.width, maxHeight: bubble.height }, "aria-live": "polite" }, text) : null,
        model.avatarFeedback && geometry?.avatarTarget?.source !== "avatar" ? h("div", { className: "dcr-live-fallback-stars", "aria-hidden": true, style: { left: geometry?.avatarTarget?.x ?? 0, top: geometry?.avatarTarget?.y ?? 0 } }, "\u2726 \u2726 \u2726") : null
      ) : null);
    }
    return { CharacterStageLive, CharacterStageControls };
  }

  // stage/ai-actions.js
  var AI_RELEASE = "1.2.0";
  var sum = (xs) => xs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  var frames = (name) => manifest_default.tracks[name].frames;
  var duration = (name) => sum(frames(name).map((f) => f.duration));
  var PUNCH_SOURCE_INDICES = Object.freeze([0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7]);
  var PUNCH_TIMES = Object.freeze([80, 80, 130, 110, 100, 80, 70]);
  var PUNCH_DURATION = sum(PUNCH_TIMES);
  var PUNCH_CONTACT = 160;
  var PLACE_RELEASE = sum(frames("place-stone").slice(0, 5).map((f) => f.duration));
  var PICKUP_CONTACT = sum(frames("take-stone").slice(0, 4).map((f) => f.duration));
  var AI_MOVE = Object.freeze([
    ["thinking", 550, "thinking"],
    ["pickup", duration("take-stone"), "pickup"],
    ["carrying", duration("hold-stone"), "carry"],
    ["placing", duration("place-stone"), "place"],
    ["smug", 700, "smug"],
    ["retreat", 1650, "walk"]
  ].map(Object.freeze));
  var AI_DEFEAT = Object.freeze([
    ["pout", 300, "pout"],
    ["stomp", duration("pout-stomp") - 300, "stomp"],
    ["run-avatar", 1500, "walk"],
    ["punch", PUNCH_DURATION, "punch"],
    ["punch", PUNCH_DURATION, "punch"],
    ["punch", PUNCH_DURATION, "punch"],
    ["arms-crossed", duration("cross-arms"), "arms-crossed"],
    ["invite", 650, "invite"],
    ["retreat", 1400, "walk"]
  ].map(Object.freeze));
  var AI_RELEASE_AT = 550 + duration("take-stone") + duration("hold-stone") + PLACE_RELEASE;
  var AI_HOLD_AT = 550 + PICKUP_CONTACT;
  var phaseTracks = { pickup: "take-stone", carrying: "hold-stone", placing: "place-stone", pout: "pout-stomp", stomp: "pout-stomp", punch: "punch-small", "arms-crossed": "cross-arms", retreat: "walk-right", "run-avatar": "walk-right", roam: "walk-right" };
  function indexAt(times, elapsed, loop = false) {
    const total2 = sum(times);
    let t = Math.max(0, Number.isFinite(elapsed) ? elapsed : 0);
    t = loop ? t % total2 : Math.min(t, total2 - 1e-3);
    let index = 0;
    while (index < times.length - 1 && t >= times[index]) t -= times[index++];
    return index;
  }
  function sampleAiAction(model) {
    if (model?.actionClock !== "dsh-chess-ai-v1") return null;
    if (model.phase === "placing" && model.phaseElapsed >= PLACE_RELEASE) return null;
    const track = phaseTracks[model.phase];
    if (!track) return null;
    const spec = manifest_default.tracks[track];
    let time = Math.max(0, model.phaseElapsed ?? 0);
    if (model.phase === "stomp") time += 300;
    const index = model.phase === "punch" ? PUNCH_SOURCE_INDICES[indexAt(PUNCH_TIMES, time)] : indexAt(spec.frames.map((f) => f.duration), time, spec.loop);
    const frame = spec.frames[index];
    const directional = track === "walk-right" || track === "punch-small";
    const nativeFacing = track === "punch-small" ? "right" : spec.nativeFacing;
    const mirror = directional && nativeFacing !== "front" && model.facing !== nativeFacing;
    const point = frame.stone;
    return {
      track,
      index,
      frame,
      mirror,
      cycleKey: `${model.eventId ?? "roam"}:${model.segmentIndex ?? 0}`,
      stone: point ? { x: (mirror ? 384 - point.x : point.x) / 384, y: point.y / 384 } : null
    };
  }
  var releasePoint = frames("place-stone")[4].stone;
  if (!releasePoint) throw new Error("AI place contact anchor is required");
  var AI_ACTION_PROFILE = Object.freeze({
    move: AI_MOVE,
    defeat: AI_DEFEAT,
    releaseAt: AI_RELEASE_AT,
    holdAt: AI_HOLD_AT,
    releasePalm: Object.freeze({ x: releasePoint.x / 384, y: releasePoint.y / 384 }),
    placementMs: PLACE_RELEASE,
    punchContact: PUNCH_CONTACT,
    punchFeedbackEnd: 400,
    palm(phase, elapsed, facing) {
      return sampleAiAction({ phase, phaseElapsed: elapsed, facing, actionClock: "dsh-chess-ai-v1" })?.stone ?? this.releasePalm;
    }
  });

  // stage/ai-artwork.js
  function aiFrameUrl(pose, color = 2) {
    const urls = AI_FRAME_URLS[pose.track]?.[color === 1 ? "black" : "white"];
    const url = urls?.[pose.index];
    if (!url?.startsWith("data:image/")) throw new Error("undeclared-ai-frame");
    return url;
  }
  function createAiStageArtwork(React) {
    const h = React.createElement, LegacyActor = createStageArtwork(React);
    function Actor(props) {
      const { model, runtimeId, reduced, t, dragEnabled, onPointerDown, onPointerMove, onPointerUp, onArtError } = props;
      const pose = reduced ? null : sampleAiAction(model);
      const [failed, setFailed] = React.useState(false), alive = React.useRef(true), errorGuard = React.useRef("");
      const signature = `${runtimeId}:${model.gameId}:${model.version}:${pose?.cycleKey}:${pose?.index}`;
      errorGuard.current = signature;
      React.useEffect(() => {
        alive.current = true;
        return () => {
          alive.current = false;
        };
      }, []);
      React.useEffect(() => setFailed(false), [runtimeId, model.eventId, model.phase]);
      React.useEffect(() => {
        if (!pose || document.hidden) return;
        const images = AI_FRAME_URLS[pose.track][model.stoneColor === 1 ? "black" : "white"].map((src) => {
          const image = new Image();
          image.src = src;
          image.decode?.().catch(() => {
          });
          return image;
        });
        return () => {
          for (const image of images) {
            image.onload = null;
            image.onerror = null;
            image.src = "";
          }
        };
      }, [pose?.track, model.stoneColor, runtimeId]);
      if (!pose || failed) {
        const phase = model.phase === "placing" && model.phaseElapsed >= PLACE_RELEASE ? "smug" : model.phase;
        const legacyPhase = ["pickup", "carrying", "pout", "stomp", "punch", "arms-crossed", "retreat", "roam", "run-avatar"].includes(phase) ? "idle" : phase;
        const clean = {
          ...model,
          phase: legacyPhase,
          facing: "right",
          heldStone: null,
          hand: { x: model.x + model.width * RIGHT_PALM.x, y: model.y + model.height * RIGHT_PALM.y }
        };
        return h(LegacyActor, { ...props, model: clean });
      }
      return h(
        "div",
        {
          className: `dcr-motion-actor phase-${model.phase}`,
          style: { width: model.width, height: model.height, transform: `translate(${model.x}px,${model.y}px)` },
          "data-drag": dragEnabled ? "true" : "false",
          "data-phase": model.phase,
          "data-dcr-ai-track": pose.track,
          "data-dcr-ai-frame": pose.index + 1,
          "data-dcr-ai-cycle": pose.cycleKey,
          "data-dcr-ai-generation": "1.2.0",
          onPointerDown,
          onPointerMove,
          onPointerUp,
          onPointerCancel: onPointerUp,
          onLostPointerCapture: onPointerUp
        },
        h(
          "div",
          { className: "dcr-motion-art", style: { width: "100%", height: "100%" } },
          h("img", {
            key: signature,
            src: aiFrameUrl(pose, model.stoneColor),
            alt: t("art"),
            draggable: false,
            style: { transform: pose.mirror ? "scaleX(-1)" : void 0 },
            onError: () => {
              if (!alive.current || errorGuard.current !== signature) return;
              setFailed(true);
              onArtError("stageArtError");
            }
          })
        )
      );
    }
    return Actor;
  }

  // host/dialogue.js
  var unquoted = (text) => String(text ?? "").replace(/```[\s\S]*?```|`[^`]*`|“[^”]*”|「[^」]*」|『[^』]*』|"[^"]*"/g, "");
  function requestsQuiet(text) {
    const plain = unquoted(text).replace(/(?:不要|不想|不必|不用|不喜欢|不是要|别让我|别)安静(?:点|一点|些|一下)?/g, "");
    return /(?:请|保持|能不能|你能|我要|我想|让我|要|想)?安静(?:点|一点|些|一下|下棋|地|！|!|。|$)|(?:别|不要|不用|停止|不许|不必)(?:再|一直|继续|总)?(?:说话|说了|讲话|聊天|废话|唠叨|斗嘴|调侃|挑衅|评论|发言|开口)|少说(?:点|一点|些)|闭嘴|静音|专心下棋|专注(?:下棋|棋盘)|只下棋不聊天|^不喜欢[。！!]*$|不喜欢(?:你的?|这些|这种)?(?:说话|聊天|斗嘴|调侃|挑衅|评论)|(?:be|keep)\s+quiet|\bquiet\s+please\b|stop\s+(?:talking|chatting|commenting)|no\s+(?:more\s+)?(?:comments|banter)|\bmute\b/i.test(plain);
  }
